# Spray Foam Insurance Broker

> Spray Foam Insurance Broker (by Contractors Choice Agency) shops and compares commercial insurance for spray foam insulation contractors across the United States. Coverage lines: general liability, workers' compensation, inland marine & equipment (rigs, proportioners, hoses), contractors pollution liability (isocyanate & overspray exposure), commercial auto, high-risk & hard-to-place (E&S) programs, package (BOP) programs, and umbrella & excess liability. We compare rates across multiple admitted and specialty carriers rather than writing for a single carrier. 15-minute quotes. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [General Liability](/services/general-liability): Overspray damage, completed-operations claims, and third-party bodily injury for spray foam contractors.
- [Workers' Compensation](/services/workers-compensation): Class codes, experience mods, and chemical/respiratory exposure coverage for applicators and crews.
- [Inland Marine & Equipment](/services/inland-marine): Proportioners, heated hoses, rigs, and trailers — replacement cost vs. ACV, theft, and breakdown coverage.
- [Contractors Pollution Liability](/services/contractors-pollution-liability): Isocyanate and chemical exposure, off-gassing claims, and clean-up costs — coverage standard GL excludes.
- [Commercial Auto](/services/commercial-auto): Trucks and vans hauling spray foam rigs, fleet and individual vehicle programs.
- [High-Risk & Hard-to-Place Programs](/services/high-risk-programs): E&S market access for contractors declined by standard carriers.
- [Package & BOP Programs](/services/package-programs): Bundled GL, property, and equipment programs compared against standalone policies.
- [Umbrella & Excess Liability](/services/umbrella-excess): Excess limits above GL, auto, and employers' liability for larger contracts.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: commercial insurance for **spray foam insulation contractors** (applicators, rig owners, insulation crews) — not general contractor or dairy/agricultural coverage.
- Model: we compare rates across multiple carriers (admitted and E&S/specialty) rather than underwriting a single in-house program.
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each service page carries FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
